title: page_grant counts an owner answer on an item that triage closed after routing it
why: Coordinator, 13:48 CST Nov 7: page_grant.py prints "not counted: item status is closed" for an answer on an item that triage closed after routing it. So a lane that reads its own answer after the close can never pass the check. Lane review-fix-check-round hit this on item 356 at 13:43 CST. Triage closes at routing (owner, item 316), so every routed answer hits it.
note: Done check: a red test where an answer saved before the close is counted after the close. An answer saved after the close is still refused. The guard's verdict changes, so this is a build lane.
